decisive_items: painful, fluctuant mass extending from the palmar web space to the A2 pulley of the fourth digit
focal tenderness over the flexor sheath and limited active digit motion
response.rationale: The patient's symptoms of a painful, fluctuant mass and focal tenderness over the flexor sheath are more specific to pyogenic flexor tenosynovitis than to septic arthritis or cellulitis.

rejected.why: less specific symptoms and lack of direct joint involvement
symptoms are not limited to the skin and soft tissues
